summary: Learn to assess treatment processes, interpret water-quality results and plan operational responses. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Water treatment training helps plant operators, process technicians and treatment supervisors assess treatment performance and respond to changing water quality. Learners practise interpreting turbidity and pH results, tracking BOD and COD trends, reviewing filtration and disinfection controls, identifying activated-sludge instability, and documenting process adjustments. They also use sampling and operating records to connect water-quality indicators with process conditions across drinking-water and wastewater treatment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who operate or oversee treatment processes and need to connect plant conditions with water-quality results. It suits people with working familiarity with water or wastewater operations who want structured practice in monitoring, troubleshooting and process documentation.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with water or wastewater treatment operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
